prompt: In a cinematic film still, the humid air of a sprawling botanical greenhouse hangs heavy with mist. On the far left, an elderly woman in a floral dress stands beside a rusted iron bench. Next to her, a young boy in a blue cap points eagerly at a towering fern. The fern’s fronds brush against the glass ceiling above. In the center foreground, a gardener in green overalls kneels on the wet stone floor, pruning a vibrant orchid with silver shears. A white cat sits calmly on the gardener’s knee, watching the blade. To the right of the gardener, a terracotta pot rests on a wooden crate, holding a blooming cactus. Behind them, a couple shares a moment; the man in a grey suit looks at the woman in a yellow scarf, who holds a sketchbook open. Her pencil hovers over the paper as she draws the scene. Further back, a tour guide in a khaki vest gestures toward a hanging pitcher plant. Five tourists listen intently: a girl with pigtails, a man with a beard, a woman with sunglasses on her head, a teenager in a hoodie, and an older gentleman with a cane. The teenager in the hoodie leans against a support pillar. The older gentleman with the cane taps the ground lightly. Above the group, a large glass dome reflects the cloudy sky. A brass watering can lies on its side near the entrance. A dragonfly hovers near the orchid. The sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled shadows. There is no digital clock visible on any wall. There is no plastic signage indicating plant names. There is no modern electronic device in anyone’s hand.
